Agent Name: Historian_Expert
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: The Historian_Expert made a critical error in the very first step by incorrectly identifying the first citation reference link on Carl Nebel's Wikipedia page. The conversation shows that the first citation (reference [[1]](#cite_note-thb-1)) points to "Thieme-Becker" (a German biographical dictionary), not the Museum of Fine Arts, Houston (MFAH) website as the Historian claimed. This fundamental error led the team to search the wrong website (MFAH) instead of the correct source (Thieme-Becker), causing all subsequent steps to be based on incorrect premises and resulting in the failure to find the relevant image and date.
